About Us

End to End Human Capital Solutions for Sustainable Growth

Founded in Tangerang City, Indonesia, PT PRAXA Consulting serves national-scale organizations including state-owned enterprises (SOEs), private companies, and public sector institutions across a wide range of industries.

Our Vision

"To be the most trusted strategic human capital partner, helping leaders achieve superior business performance through exceptional people and high-performing organizations."

Our Mission

To deliver exceptional consulting solutions focused on client success, turning human capital strategies into measurable business impact while cultivating resilient leaders and sustainable organizational cultures.

OUR PHILOSOPHY

Human Centered. Data Driven. Business Oriented.

People Create Value

Every transformation begins and ends with people. People become the true competitive advantage when strategy, structure, and culture work as one.

Evidence Beats Opinion

Strategic decisions are driven by concrete data, objective assessments, and in-depth analysis not assumptions.

Impact is The Only Proof

We measure our success by the measurable improvements in our clients' business performance and return on investment (ROI).
